Both refinements are in. Reload **http://maker:4001/app.html** and confirm:

> 1. There's now a **Mark as read** action in the bar (beside Mark read later). Open the **To read** tab, select an item there, and press **Mark as read** — it leaves the To read list and the selection **clears**, since it's no longer in view.
> 2. On the **All** tab, select a couple, **Add tag** `review` — the selection **stays**, so you can immediately do another action (they're still in view).
> 3. Still on All, select some and **Archive** — they leave the main list and the selection **clears**.
> 4. Edge of the same rule: search `#reference`, **Select all shown**, then **Remove tag** `reference` — because they no longer match the active `#reference` filter, they drop out of view and the selection **clears**.

So the rule is: the selection **persists while the affected items remain in the current search/tags/view, and clears the moment an action pushes them out** — and "Select all shown" always means exactly what matches your current search, tags, and view.

Does this now match what you intended for bulk actions?
